proposal.name: Name unfinished Gobra proofs and report their times

plan.name: Name unfinished Gobra proofs and report their times
plan.summary: Keep D-0144's single 20-minute package deadline, pinned Gobra image, proof coverage, overflow checks, cancellation cleanup and gate-error classification, while collecting the pinned verifier's actual member-start and member-completion reports during its existing package run so a timeout identifies unfinished functions and receiver-qualified methods and reports every completed member's elapsed proof time. Retain partial progress in gobra.Run's result and a gobra.TimeoutError carrying Limit and Progress, distinguish observed active members from selected members whose completion was not reported, use source-relative names rather than temporary host paths, preserve a bounded useful output tail, and never infer completion, duration or proof success from source discovery, a start event or missing output. Carry the same diagnostic through the existing gate-tool error, synthesis final-gate error, factory failure post and CLI error paths; add optional code.proof_progress JSON to completed reports and list completed members with durations in slowest-first order in both gate feedback and Markdown receipts, treating progress as operational diagnostics excluded from evidence fingerprints and leaving old reports and proof outcomes compatible. Check the actual logging options and output against the existing pinned Gobra image, capture representative success, proof-failure and interrupted-output fixtures, and add parser and command-boundary regressions for concurrent and duplicate events, incomplete output, receiver identity, source selection and cancellation plus an integration-tagged test in internal/verify that exercises real successful member timings and a named function whose proof exceeds a short deadline, with observed progress required so static source inventory alone cannot pass it. Update SPEC.md with this behavior and a citation to [#946's ratified plan](.invariant/plans/issue-946.json), and document the diagnostics, timing meaning and short real-tool test in docs/gate.md, preserving the README's existing front-page description.

tests.name: TestGobra946ShortTimeoutNamesTheFunction
tests.says: A Gobra run stopped at a short deadline names the selected function whose completion is missing, retains useful partial output and still removes its container.

tests.name: TestGobra946TimeoutDistinguishesMethodsAndSelectedSources
tests.says: When no member completion was reported, timeout diagnostics distinguish same-named methods by receiver and source, include every selected member, exclude unselected and test files, and do not invent timings.

tests.name: TestGobra946FinishedTimesReachFeedbackAndReceipt
tests.says: Completed proof times survive report JSON and appear beside their source and receiver-qualified symbol in gate feedback and CI's Markdown receipt, slowest first, without changing verdicts or evidence fingerprints.

tests.name: TestGobra946FactoryPostKeepsPartialProofProgress
tests.says: A final-gate timeout's public factory post names active and other unfinished proofs and keeps every completed proof's duration, including a completed proof that was not among the slowest.

tests.name: TestGobra946CIGateLogNamesTheUnfinishedProof
tests.says: The actual verify command's timeout log names the unfinished proof and keeps exit status 2 without writing a completed receipt.

usage.summary: Wrote [plan.json](plan.json) and five acceptance tests for Gobra timeout diagnostics and proof timings, leaving `repo/` unchanged. The check passed: all five tests fail on the base code; the trusted-base change requires a person to merge.
